Star webPRNT SDK 1.10.0, Star Micronics Co., Ltd.

These two unmodified JavaScript files come from the official
[star-micronics/starwebprnt-sdk](https://github.com/star-micronics/starwebprnt-sdk)
repository, `Sample/js/StarWebPrintBuilder.js` and
`Sample/js/StarWebPrintTrader.js`.

The SDK uses the iOS Star webPRNT Browser's local endpoint at
`http://localhost:8001/StarWebPRNT/SendMessage`.
